notes.title: Leaderboard Reset + Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello,

A new update for DROPSOL has been released!

1) I've noticed a bug that, when the player was constantly close to the wall, they would not affected by the beams. This was allowing players to reach for "infinite" scores. I've now fixed this bug. Sorry about that! I've also reseted the Score Leaderboard due to this bug.

2) Three Steam Achievements have been added: one for getting 10,000+ Score, one for 50,000+ and the last one for 100,000+!

That's it for this update. 
Thank you for playing DROPSOL and good luck getting the WORLD RECORD! ːfunnycubeː

LGV

notes.title: DROPSOL is now available! What's your biggest score?
notes.content:
Hello!

Remember that DROPSOL has a global leaderboard, so you can submit your high score if you want to! ːsteamhappyː

LGV
